Spectral analysis of extremes

Source: R/advanced-extremes.R
spectral_analysis_extremes.Rd

Performs a simple spectral density estimation on the indicator series of exceedances above a threshold.

Usage

spectral_analysis_extremes(x, threshold)

Arguments

x

Numeric vector.

threshold

Numeric threshold for exceedances.

Value

List with frequency and spectral density components as returned by [stats::spectrum()].

Examples

x <- rnorm(1000)
spectral_analysis_extremes(x, threshold = 2)
